neighbours.label: the noun that closes a generalising qualifier ('up to a certain point', 'in many forms', 'varies in individuals', 'the reason for'): the word that marks a claim as holding only to some degree or across cases
fire: Exercise helps with stress, though only up to a certain point.
Friendship can take many forms, from letters to long walks.
Reactions to the vaccine differ among individuals, as do recovery times.
The size of the refund depends on the store and the reason for the return.
Spicy food is good for you, but only to a certain point.
Art comes in many forms, and each one teaches something different.
Sensitivity to caffeine varies between individuals more than people think.
The length of the delay depends on the airline and the reason for the cancellation.
quiet: Exercise helps with stress, and many people walk every morning.
Friendship grew between the two neighbors over long walks.
Reactions to the vaccine were recorded by the nurse after lunch.
The size of the refund was printed on the receipt by the clerk.
Spicy food is popular in the south, and the markets sell fresh chilies.
Art was taught in the old school building near the river.
Coffee was served to the guests after the long meeting ended.
The length of the delay was announced over the airport speakers.
